subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 3: /w/ (wag, wig, wet, wall, will); sound differentiation

show.line: Listen. w, w, wet. The dog's tail goes wag, wag! Wag starts with w.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with w, as in wet?
Say the sound with me. w, as in wall!
Listen. w, a, g. What word is it?
Is it w or v? Listen. Wet.

hints: Make your lips round like a kiss. w, w, w.
w has round lips. v has teeth.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. w, i, g.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! w, i, g makes wig.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. w, i, g. Wig!

parent_line: Can hear the w sound and blend words like wag, wig and wet.
